Hero_Desc_Guin:
A penguin werebeast who arrived in Elias while exploring with her younger sibling, Delia.
They are always bustling about, eager to explore this mysterious world called Elias.
No one can stop the passion of Guin and Delia for adventure.
Album_Guin1: Guin is an explorer who drifted into Elias. She claims to have come from the far south and seems to have gone through many hardships on her journey here.
Album_Guin2: She enjoys interacting with the residents of Elias, sharing stories about her home planet. Occasionally, she visits the Werebeast Village, where she tells tales of her adventures and stays for a few days.
Album_Guin3: The more aggressive werebeasts, like Tig, seem wary of Guin. Her cold expression and demeanor make them instinctively uneasy, though Guin herself doesn't seem to care.
Album_Guin4: As a fellow drifter in Elias, Guin seems to feel a strong sense of kinship with me. She often asks for advice and frequently asks me questions about the culture of Elias, eager to understand it better.
Album_Guin5: Guin has a habit of climbing Elemental Mountain on foot, seeking to conquer its unclaimed peaks. For some reason, she hired Mago as a "Sherpa," but it seems like a huge misunderstanding. Since Guin pays her a sum that Mago can't refuse, she has no choice but to climb Elemental Mountain, likely just for the sake of her animal friends.
Album_Guin6: The Elementals are struggling to figure out how to handle Guin, who constantly ascends their mountain. They tried to chase her out, claiming it was their territory, but they couldn't stop her relentless drive to explore. Eventually, they just gave up and started issuing her passage permits, seemingly accepting her as one of their own.
Album_Guin7: Guin says that once she has fully mapped out Elias, she wants to explore other lands. She dreams of traveling the entire world and creating a complete world map. She subtly hints at wanting me to join her on this grand journey.
LoveHero_Guin: Let's pioneer the world together, Master!
LoveHeroCancel_Guin: Tsk! Isn't it too early to give up?
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Hate1: While exploring the Werebeast Village, Guin once found some canned chow buried in a pit and tried eating it a few times. However, even after trying it again, she still couldn't stand the taste.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Hate2: She got excited, thinking they were receiving a precious gem, only to realize it was just a candy. Her face immediately turned gloomy. Now I feel bad...
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like1: It's not as cold as an Ice Cube Snack, but it's still refreshing and cool enough to enjoy.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like2: She was overjoyed to taste a fish dish for the first time since being stranded. Maybe she had been longing for a taste of her home planet?
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like3: Sometimes, just tasting a famous dish from a region can make you feel like you're exploring that place. She loved that idea.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like4: She asked if it was a souvenir representing Elias' lush forests and abundant trees, getting excited about how perfect it was as a gift.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like5: For an explorer, portable food is as essential as light and salt. They treasured Sour Vita as if it were a precious treasure.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like6: Her curious nature kicked in, and she started stuffing strange materials into rice cakes, trying to create a new type of Songpyeon. That's how the kitchen was left in a complete mess...
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like7: After freezing Almond Pralines in the fridge and trying it, she decided she loved it and wanted to pack some to take home. Looks like she plans to share it with her younger sibling, Delia.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like8: She insisted that proper nutrition is essential for great discoveries and pioneering efforts, urging me to take some Vita-C as well. In the end, Guin and I shared it together.
Food_ChefNote_Guin_Like9: Guin wanted to test their explorer's intuition and started guessing the flavor of candies based on their colors. After correctly identifying all 7 flavors, she looked incredibly happy.

LoveLetter_Guin:
Delias... No, after coming to this new place called Elias, many things felt unfamiliar. Sprites who eat sugar all day, for instance, and wind without the scent of salt.

Still, thanks to you looking after Delia and me, Master, I think I am doing well and staying strong.

More friends besides us will probably find their way here, right? When they do, I will help you so they can settle in comfortably.

Let us go on an adventure together sometime!
LoveCall_Guin:
Master~! Something made me curious, so I called to ask you about it.
What was the place where you used to live like?

Huh? Why am I suddenly asking?
The thought simply occurred to me: where should I explore next?
Ah! Of course, I do not dislike Elias. Everyone here is kind, and it is a warm, wonderful place.
But I am an explorer, so someday I want to set out for an unknown world.
While wondering where I should go if I ever left, I became curious about the place where you originally lived.
That is why I asked.

How did you live there, Master? What place did you like most, and what did you enjoy doing?
If you ever return there someday... may I come explore it with you?
I think it would be wonderful if I could stay with you even in another world.

Well then, Master, I will come see you soon, so answer my questions when I do~!
